uncited: *   **Octree Nodes:** Store culling metadata and pointers to bricks.
**Culling:** For each child of the current node, perform culling tests.
The method was introduced by Crassin et al. [CNLE09] as a scheme for out-of-core rendering.
It has been implemented in the Voreen volume rendering framework [DLJL22].
Brix et al. [BPH14] extended this approach to multi-channel data sets.
